name: @dmpunk/pi-agy
description: Delegate low-level tasks (writing code, exploring codebases, research passes) to Google Antigravity's agy CLI / Gemini agent from pi. Live status shows what the agent is doing (file edited, command run) and agy_fleet fans out multiple agents in parallel.
